name: NYC Cat Coalition (NYC Bronx Westchester Cat Coalition)
notes: 100% no-kill, all-volunteer 501(c)(3) (EIN 13-3144256). TNR in/around the Bronx + rescue from streets & owner surrender + adoption. Checks email regularly. Active 2026. Intake: Email for adoption application Intake: adoption center at Pelham Manor PetSmart Other channel: FB @NYCCatCoalition
